title: Vesper and the Autopsy
author: Sable Thornbury
blurb: Theo Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
